limits: Static whole-file/function review is distinct from test execution and correctness proof.
Generated outputs are checked against generators; third-party dependencies, compiled/cache output and historical prose/evidence are not claimed as handwritten line audits.
Python source/function metrics include scripts and migrations. Browser source-map metrics exclude unavailable mappings and are an approximation after compilation.

Some worker processes are intentionally SIGKILLed; lost in-memory coverage cannot be recovered even though DB/fault assertions execute. The Node-launched Python preview server also lacks trace collection. No recorded hit is not proof that a function never executed.
